text: The Cyclone Preparedness Programme (CPP) Modernization is an initiative in Bangladesh aimed at reducing cyclone mortality and losses through a community-volunteer model. The program, a joint effort between the Government of Bangladesh and the Bangladesh Red Crescent Society, focuses on early warning, evacuation, sheltering, first aid, search and rescue, and post-disaster relief and recovery. The modernization phase, starting in 2018, includes gender parity among volunteers, risk communication, and evacuation support for displaced Myanmar nationals in Cox’s Bazar camps.
